title: Meetings & hybrid participation
subtitle: Schedule community meetings, record attendance and minutes, track decisions, and request secure remote participation.
safetyBody: Attendance may be provisional. Meeting decisions do not authorize payments or ledger postings. Offline minutes remain local until a configured, trusted TITech sync workflow accepts them.
empty: No meetings were found for this view.
localDraftNote: Local only. These drafts are not yet accepted or synced by the server.
selectMeeting: Select a meeting to review its agenda, attendance and records.
attendanceNotice: Attendance is provisional and does not prove identity or physical presence.
minutesPlaceholder: Draft minutes. Avoid unnecessary sensitive personal data.
localConsent: I understand this draft is stored in this browser and may be accessible to someone using this device.
localDataWarning: Local browser storage is not encrypted by this feature. Use a private, trusted device. Sync is not confirmed until the server accepts the event.
localPending: Saved locally only — pending server acceptance
decisionNotice: This records a decision. It does not establish formal quorum/voting validity or authorize any financial action.
joinVideo: Get access and open video room
tokenIssued: A short-lived join grant was issued and opened in a new tab if permitted. Expires at
financialBoundary: Meeting decisions never post money. Use TITech’s existing authorized financial workflow.
timezoneNote: Schedule times are interpreted by the browser and stored as ISO timestamps; the default organization zone is Africa/Kampala.
